name: Interview with a succubus
source:
«Finally someone summons you for your services! No one has contacted you for three days, it’s unacceptable for a professional succubus to remain so long without human souls to heal! The human who summoned you, however, has a rather curious kink: they want to play interviewer! Curious, yes, but a professional succubus doesn’t hold back at anything! … Well, the human refuses every flirt and seems focused on your answers. The whole interview thing is just a role-playing game, isn’t it…? It’s not like there’s a human who summoned a succubus just to do an interview, right…?»

[from [url=https://wisteria-sakana.itch.io/interview-with-a-succubus]itch.io[/url]]
